jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern (English Speaker)
jobs.description: As a Junior Recruiter at KitaLulus, you will support end-to-end talent sourcing by identifying, engaging, and screening potential candidates for our client partners. Key Responsibility: a. The Hunt: Use LinkedIn, specialized databases, and creative sourcing methods to find candidates who aren't even looking for a job. b. The Pitch: Reach out to potential candidates and "sell" the vision of our client partners. c. Screening: Conduct initial interviews to assess if a candidate has the "right stuff" beyond just a resume. d. Pipeline Management: Keep our database clean and ensure no great candidate falls through the cracks. e. Market Mapping: Research industries to understand who the movers and shakers are in specific sectors. Job Requirements: a. Communicator: You can talk to anyone, from a junior dev to a C-suite executive, with confidence and clarity. b. Resilient: Headhunting involves a lot of "nos" before you get to the "yes." You have thick skin and a positive outlook. c. Curious: You love learning how different businesses work and what makes a person successful in their career. d. Experience: 0-2 years of experience. (We are more than happy to welcome fresh graduates who bring high energy and a great attitude to the team) e. Language: Comfortable using English for daily communication and in professional setting (written and verbal).

jobs.description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Als “Senior Recruiter” im Team Recruiting von freiheit.com sind dies Deine Verantwortungsbereiche: Active Sourcing auf Top-Niveau: Du verlässt dich nicht auf eingehende Bewerbungen, sondern spürst per Active Sourcing die besten Talente auf. Du findest genau die Menschen, die das Mindset, den Willen und die Disziplin mitbringen, um mit uns „Mission Impossible“-Projekte Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen. Klasse statt Masse: Dein Ziel ist es nicht, Bewerberzahlen künstlich aufzublähen, sondern von vornherein die richtige

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard tech

jobs.description: D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies. D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L. D2L has had a singular mission for over 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally. D2L has a hybrid working model based on proximity to our working spaces. We hire both remotely, and hybrid out of our office locations. While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations. As the Talent Acquisition Partner focused on Technical and Product Recruitment, you will help build teams that create and improve D2L products. Reporting to the TA Operations Lead, you will own and prioritize full-cycle searches and advise hiring managers on how to attract and assess experienced technical and product talent. You understand the requirements behind technical and product roles and can help teams build clear, job-related interview processes. You will bring market insight, thoughtful sourcing and strong candidate advocacy to every search. jobs.description: MissionWired and BWF Zuri are sister companies with a shared purpose: helping nonprofits and progressive organizations raise the money that moves their missions forward. Together, we walk alongside our partners through the whole donor journey, from building communities of supporters at scale to landing the transformational gifts that change what’s possible. We know fundraising is getting harder. Fewer people are giving, everyone is competing for attention, goals keep growing, and technology and AI are changing how supporters connect with the causes they care about. Our partners need people who will dream big with them, then roll up their sleeves and make it happen. At MissionWired, we help nonprofit organizations and Democratic campaigns advance their revenue and cause. Our team brings tech intelligence, empathetic storytelling, and an unrivaled agility to every partnership. We proudly work alongside world-changing nonprofit clients including Human Rights Watch, Innocence Project, and the American Red Cross – as well as major Democratic committees and competitive Senate and gubernatorial races. At BWF Zuri, the nonprofit sector’s most comprehensive fundraising consulting firm, we support every step of the donor journey. That means the systems and programs that keep supporters engaged, the strategies that inspire generosity, and the expertise it takes to secure major gifts and make every donor feel valued. At heart, we’re progress-obsessed do-gooders who care deeply about social change. We bring deep expertise, fresh thinking, and talented people to every partnership, all in service of stronger fundraising, closer donor relationships, and lasting impact. jobs.title: HR-Stagiair(e)
jobs.description: Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen. Jouw stage: Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Waar draag je aan bij? Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten. Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie. De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie). Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten. Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties. Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen. Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een stagiair(e) die: Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027. Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week. Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt

jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering voor O&P Rijk , de hr-dienstverlener voor de Rijksoverheid. O&P Rijk is in 2023 ontstaan uit de samenvoeging van UBR Personeel, P-Direkt en Binnenwerk en biedt dienstverlening op het gebied van organisatie en personeel. In 2026 heeft O&P Rijk de financiële functie laten doorlichten. Deze doorlichting geeft richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële processen, rapportages, interne beheersing en de inrichting van de organisatie. Als Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan deze doorontwikkeling en werk je binnen verschillende financiële werkstromen. Je verzamelt, structureert en analyseert financiële en bedrijfskundige informatie en vertaalt deze naar verbetervoorstellen, rapportages en beslisdocumenten. Daarbij breng je samenhang, voortgang, afhankelijkheden, risico’s en knelpunten tussen de verschillende werkstromen in beeld. Je brengt informatie uit verschillende werkstromen samen tot een integraal beeld en maakt onderlinge afhankelijkheden en raakvlakken inzichtelijk. jobs.description: Talk360 connects people across 190 countries. Every day, millions rely on us to reach family, friends, customers, colleagues. We're profitable and entering new markets, but we're not planning significant headcount growth. Right now, we're a team of 35 people spread globally. Small enough to know each other's names, big enough to have real impact. As we grow, everything changes. How we hire, how we grow, what it feels like to be here. That's why we need someone who doesn't just manage HR, but shapes culture intentionally. From how we attract new colleagues, to how our people grow, reward and support the ones already here.
